data.name: OKEverything: Realm of Humanity
data.detailed_description:
OKeverything: Realm of Humanity - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction
Ethan is an ordinary community college history teacher. His peaceful life was disrupted when he fought for the custody of his daughter, Emma. While investigating the school's financial irregularities, he was unexpectedly involved in the conspiracy of the Spade Society and the Veil Club. After being framed for sexually assaulting a student, he was locked in the "Humanity Paradise", facing inhumane tests with his "sister" Sophia and "aunt" Isabella.
Worldview Atmosphere
The story constructs a surreal world full of conspiracies and darkness. The Spade Society and the Veil Club control everything. They use money and power to drag innocent people into a cruel humanity game. Here, morality and ethics are trampled on, and people have to make choices against their hearts in order to survive.
Highlights of Female Character Interactions
Sophia and Isabella support and struggle painfully with Ethan in desperate situations. Although they are controlled by drugs, they still retain a glimmer of consciousness and try to guide Ethan to resist together, showing complex and profound emotions. Their interactions are full of helplessness, pain, and warmth, which is touching.
Tension in Character Relationships
The relationships between Ethan, Sophia, and Isabella, which were originally family relationships, are distorted in extreme circumstances. They struggle between desire and morality, survival and dignity. The character relationships are full of tension and conflict, allowing players to deeply feel the complexity of human nature.
Scene Features
The story scenes range from the office of an East Coast community college to a closed glass room. Each scene is filled with a depressing and desperate atmosphere. The intense confrontation in the office and the humanity test in the glass room bring strong visual and psychological impacts.
Immersive Experience
Players will follow Ethan's perspective and delve into this world full of conspiracies and despair, feeling his fear, struggle, and pain. Every choice is a matter of life and death, and every decision tests human nature, making players feel as if they are on the scene.
High - Definition Visual Performance
The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the characters' expressions, actions, and scene details. Whether it's Ethan's anger and helplessness or Sophia and Isabella's pain and despair, they are all fully displayed through the exquisite graphics.
Functional Gameplay Features
The game supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves at any time and anywhere. The one - click backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the auto - play function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function allows players to freely choose the chapters they want to read, and high - definition CGs bring a more shocking visual experience.
